low_incidence_reroot_corollary.name: L_LT_3R_FORCES_EXACT_N_MINUS_4_REROOT
low_incidence_reroot_corollary.statement: For any legitimate canonical unit-free ordinary root/state with r>0 live variables and L<3r literal incidences, an exact ordinary pivot exists whose elimination is raw-cap safe whenever the current state itself fits, and whose residual local encoding size is at most N-4.
proof: The proved integer-average-degree corollary gives a live variable x with incidence d_x<=floor(L/r)<=2.
d_x cannot be zero for a live variable, so d_x is 1 or 2.
If d_x=1, the proved degree-1 lemma applies: one polarity bucket is empty, no resolvent is produced, and deleting the unique unit-free clause plus x reduces local encoding size by at least 4.
If d_x=2 and x is pure, one polarity bucket is empty and elimination is pure deletion of two pivot clauses; this reduces local encoding size by at least 4.
If d_x=2 and x is mixed, then p=q=1. The proved generic whole-state raw bound gives B_x=s+1-2-2=s-3 because the U terms have zero coefficients.
The exact capped output therefore has state_units at most s-3; at least x disappears, so live variables are at most r-1. Hence N'<=s-3+r-1=N-4.
No heuristic choice is used: scanning incidence degrees and choosing any certified d_x<=2 pivot is deterministic and polynomial.

inductive_partition.statement: For N in 31..41 and any legitimate canonical unit-free root, one of three existing exact corridors applies.

cases.conclusion: The proved <=4-clause invariant prevents clause-count growth throughout ordinary elimination; its raw-size corollary is far below the original N^2 cap in this range.
The low-incidence reroot corollary gives N'<=N-4; strong induction on N and cap monotonicity completes the residual.
Since N=1+m+L+r>=6+4r, r<=floor((N-6)/4). The existing exact T/Smax/Uraw recurrence is cap-safe for every such r for N=31..41.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N41
theorem.statement: Using N<=30 as the induction base, the existing <=4-clause invariant, the composed L<3r low-incidence reroot corollary, cap monotonicity, and the already-proved T/Smax/Uraw recurrence, every legitimate root of encoding size N<=41 has an ordinary exact cap-safe continuation to the exact terminal lanes without requiring v2/v3 because of raw-cap unavailability.

derivation: Hard region also assumes m0>=5, hence m0=5 and L0=27.
This is a balanced degree-3-average root cell. It is not asserted to fail; only the present sufficient induction no longer closes it automatically.
